description: Run a shell command in the project directory. PowerShell on Windows, bash elsewhere; see shell in <env>. A non-zero exit code is reported in the result, it is not a tool error.
name: bash

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the project root (default: the root)

description: Replace the only occurrence of old with new in a file. Read the file first. Empty old creates a new file.
name: edit

allow_shrink.description: Allow removing more than half of the lines of a file with 20+ lines

old.description: Exact text to replace, with enough lines to be unique

path.description: File path, relative to the project root

description: List files matching a glob pattern, e.g. src/**/*.rs. Returns sorted paths, up to 500. Skips files ignored by .gitignore.
name: glob

pattern.description: Glob pattern, relative to the project root

description: Apply several edit replacements to one file in order. All or nothing: if any edit fails, the file is not changed.
name: multi_edit

allow_shrink.description: Allow removing more than half of the lines of a file with 20+ lines

path.description: File path, relative to the project root

description: Read a text file. Returns numbered lines: line number, tab, text.
name: read

path.description: File path, relative to the project root

description: Search file contents with a regular expression. Returns path:line:text, up to 200 matches. Skips files ignored by .gitignore.
name: search

glob.description: Only files matching this glob, e.g. *.rs
